# Meterless

> Meterless turns the computer you already own into an AI hotspot. Nightshift, the flagship product, runs on a Mac, a Windows PC with a dedicated GPU, or an NVIDIA DGX Spark: by day it serves AI to every connected app over one OpenAI-compatible provider; when you step away it races hundreds of attempts at queued jobs, then reads, clusters, judges and checks them. Gaia, Relay and Swarms are free apps. Meterless City, Sitcomify and DataPlant are experiments. This repository is the open core: engine implementation specs (AGENTS.md-driven, not runtime libraries), architecture docs, benchmark summaries, product documentation, and the project narrative. Everything here is Apache 2.0. App installers live in per-app repos and on meterless.ai.

## Folder map

- /docs/products/nightshift/ : Nightshift, the flagship. How it works, job modes, the hotspot, editions and hardware, gallery.
- /docs/benchmarks/ : every published benchmark, failures included, one page each: Windows (RTX 3090), Mac M1 to M4 edition, Mac M5, DGX Spark real nights and hardware card, job modes, knowledge work, 3D, agent frameworks. Includes report captures, charts, links to live job replays, and example output copied verbatim from published jobs (examples/).
- /docs/products/gaia/ : Gaia, the free persistent AI workspace.
- /docs/products/relay/ : Relay, the free desktop workflow app. Describe the job, watch it get done, replay it with no model calls.
- /docs/products/swarms/ : Swarms, the free auto-generated agent swarm that runs in the browser.
- /docs/experiments/ : Meterless City (game), Sitcomify (photo to sitcom pilot), DataPlant (local customer-success platform).
- /docs/architecture/ : why Meterless exists, the stack, local-first context, learnings from the benchmarks.
- /docs/agent-ready/ : Claude Code and Cursor guides, the prompt library, and the Meterless provider contract.
- /docs/engines/ : one overview page per engine, linking into the spec folders.
- /docs/community/ : hackathon guide.
- /engines/hmem/ : H-MEM, hierarchical memory and durable context. Self-contained spec with AGENTS.md, docs, examples, evals, workshops.
- /engines/world-model/ : World Model, user/task/environment state modeling. Self-contained spec.
- /engines/markovian/ : Markovian, reasoning compression and next-action logic. Self-contained spec.
- /engines/scout-intent/ : Scout Intent, intent detection, risk guarding, routing, signed execution contracts. Self-contained spec with a runnable eval harness.
- /examples/memory-compounding-research/ : runnable cross-engine demo (H-MEM + Markovian, mock LLM, no keys).
- /templates/agentathon-starter/ : hackathon starter, a memory notebook agent on the H-MEM reference.

- Nightshift for Mac (preorder, $199, Q4 2026; free M1+ edition for M1 to M4 Macs): https://www.meterless.ai/mac.html
- Nightshift for DGX Spark (on request): https://www.meterless.ai/dgx-spark.html
- Free tools (Gaia, Relay, Swarms, browser utilities): https://www.meterless.ai/tools.html
- Benchmarks: https://www.meterless.ai/benchmarks.html
- Model library: https://www.meterless.ai/models.html

## Meterless provider

OpenAI-compatible. Default base URL http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1. Bearer token from <stateDir>/proxy-token. Model ids are routing modes: meterless/auto, fast, deep, cheap, local, fusion, meterless/<class>, meterless/<class>.<disposition>.

## Focused clone of one engine

npx degit meterless/meterless/engines/hmem my-hmem
